Prepare Copy Number Variation Data as SummarizedExperiment

Source: R/variable_screening.R
prepare_CNV.Rd

Processes CNV data by aligning samples with clinical data, removing constant features, and optionally performing supervised, unsupervised, or biological variable screening.

Usage

prepare_CNV(
  cnv_data,
  clinical_data,
  method = NULL,
  supervised_method = c("pval", "absmg", "padj", "mgpval"),
  unsupervised_method = c("sparsity", "laplacian"),
  p_threshold = 0.05,
  max_zero_fraction = 0.75,
  feature_fraction = 0.25,
  top_n_features = NULL,
  gene_list = NULL,
  n_neighbors = NULL,
  on_constant = c("drop", "error", "keep")
)

Arguments

cnv_data

Numeric matrix of CNV data (genes/regions as rows, samples as columns).

clinical_data

Matrix or data frame of clinical data (variables as rows, samples as columns). Must include "overall_survival" and "status" rows for supervised selection.

method

Character string for variable screening: "supervised", "unsupervised", "biological", or NULL (no selection). Default is NULL.

supervised_method

Character string specifying the supervised screening criterion, passed to supervised_screening:

  • "pval": p-value of the marginal Cox test. Supports p_threshold and top_n_features.

  • "padj": Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value. Supports p_threshold and top_n_features.

  • "absmg": absolute marginal Cox coefficient \(|\hat\beta_j|\). Requires top_n_features.

  • "mgpval": combined score \(-\log_{10}(p) \times |\hat\beta_j|\). Requires top_n_features.

Default is "pval".

unsupervised_method

Character string specifying the unsupervised screening method: "sparsity" (fraction of zero entries) or "laplacian" (Laplacian score). Default is "sparsity".

p_threshold

Numeric p-value threshold for supervised selection. Used only when supervised_method is "pval" or "padj" and top_n_features is NULL. Default is 0.05.

max_zero_fraction

Numeric proportion (0-1) for sparsity filtering: genes with a zero fraction above this value are removed. Used only when unsupervised_method = "sparsity" and top_n_features is NULL. Default is 0.75.

feature_fraction

Numeric proportion (0-1) of features retained by Laplacian screening when top_n_features is NULL. Default is 0.25.

top_n_features

Integer. If provided, overrides threshold/proportion filtering. Mandatory when supervised_method is "absmg" or "mgpval". Default is NULL.

gene_list

Character vector of feature names to retain. Used only when method = "biological". Default is NULL.

n_neighbors

Integer. Number of neighbors for Laplacian score computation (unsupervised_method = "laplacian"). Defaults to \(\approx \sqrt{n}\) if NULL.

on_constant

Character. After screening, any sample left constant (all-equal across the selected genes) is always repaired by adding back, for each such sample, the single original gene where it is most strongly altered, so that every retained sample has non-zero variance and downstream tools (e.g. flexynesis) do not drop it. Samples that are constant on the FULL input matrix carry no information and cannot be repaired; on_constant decides their fate: "drop" (default) removes them from the object, "error" stops and lists them, "keep" leaves them in (they stay constant).

Value

A SummarizedExperiment object with:

  • assays$counts: Filtered CNV matrix.

  • metadata$preprocessing: List with omics, method, sub_method, and number of features retained.
